hair.name: Hair Couture & Balayage Atelier
hair.tagline: Sculptural Precision & Color Alchemy Tailored to Your Facial Architecture

hair.introPhilosophy: Hair is sculptural art in living motion. We reject cookie-cutter formulas in favor of anatomical bone-structure analysis, custom hair-weight redistribution, and French multidimensional pigment weaving that grows out seamlessly.

services.name: Liquid Silk Keratin Restructuring
services.desc: Advanced molecular smoothing therapy eliminating up to 95% frizz while sealing mirror-finish cuticle shine.

services.name: Chronologiste Caviar Scalp & Fiber Ritual
services.desc: Sublime scalp revitalization using mimetic caviar pearls, Abyssine extract, and therapeutic shiatsu acupressure head massage.

services.name: Cysteine Organic Protein Treatment
services.desc: Formaldehyde-free organic amino acid restructuring engineered specifically for sensitized and color-compromised hair fibers.

services.name: Olaplex Molecular Bond Reconstruction
services.desc: Deep bis-aminopropyl diglycol dimaleate patented therapy rebuilding broken disulfide bonds caused by heat and chemical stress.

process.title: Consultation
process.text: We discuss your goals, lifestyle and hair history, and check condition before any product touches your hair.

process.title: Style selection
process.text: Your artist proposes a cut and colour direction and explains the trade-offs of each choice.

process.title: Professional treatment
process.text: Cut, colour or treatment is carried out in stages, with checks along the way.

process.title: Final result
process.text: A finished style, a review of home care and a plan for your next visit.
